convertibility_reason: Grid strategy with dynamic inter-grid spacing, pending order management, and margin-dependent position sizing. Grid EAs require tick-level execution and complex pending order lifecycle management that cannot be faithfully replicated in a bar-based Python backtester.

other_exits: Grid levels closed when price reaches opposite grid line with take-profit equal to grid spacing

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot size may increase at deeper grid levels depending on grid configuration; positions opened at each grid level

custom_logic_notes: Grid EA places pending buy/sell limit orders at regular price intervals above and below current price. Orders are placed at initialization and managed continuously. When one grid level is filled, the opposite side order becomes the take-profit target. Grid spacing defines both entry intervals and profit targets. No stop-loss is used; the strategy relies on price reverting within the grid range. Margin check prevents overleveraging when many grid levels are filled simultaneously.
python_conversion_notes: Grid strategy is classified mt5_only due to pending order management and tick-level grid rebalancing. A Python approximation could simulate grid levels on bar data but would miss fill timing on limit orders within bars, margin call dynamics, and the continuous order lifecycle management. If an approximation is acceptable, model grid levels as limit orders at fixed intervals from a base price, fill when bar low/high crosses the level, and close on reach of the opposite grid level.
